name: Angela
description:
100% Brazilian Remy human hair with a soft ash root blended into two different levels of lowlights and highlights for a beautiful multi dimensional blonde finish.

The lighter highlights add brightness while the deeper lowlights create depth and contrast throughout. The long layers and soft waves give her a full, luxurious look with plenty of movement.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
